name: shortly
description: The Link Shortener's domain: links, domains, referrer totals and click events, saved as JSON in the app's data home. Every page plugin injects it.
mount: a row `- id: shortly` / `name: shortly` before the page rows in blend.yaml; a page injects the `shortly` service

config.file: the JSON file, relative to the app's home (default link-shortener.json)
config.clock: what time it is, for tests
config.newId: how ids are made, for tests
